name: Yang2Swagger
what_it_is: A YANG to Swagger (OpenAPI 2.0) generator tool that converts YANG data models into RESTful API specifications compliant with the RESTCONF (RFC 8040) specification. It uses the OpenDaylight yang-tools YANG parser and can output definitions as Java objects, YAML, or JSON.
components: swagger-codegen-jaxrs (customized Jersey/JAX-RS server scaffolding code generator)
configuration: -yang-dir: directory to search for YANG modules (colon-separated for multiple)
-content-type: MIME type for API requests/responses (default application/yang-data+json)
-fullCrud: if false, only GET paths are generated (default true)
-reuse-groupings: attempt to reuse structurally identical grouping types (default false)
-simplify-hierarchy: simplified inheritance model for standard code generators (default false)
-use-namespaces: include namespaces in resource URIs (default false)
-use-odl-path-format: use bierman-02 RESTCONF path format (default false)
modes: Docker: build image with 'docker build -t yang2swagger .' then mount YANG dir and run
Maven plugin: MavenSwaggerGenerator integrated into yang-maven-plugin build lifecycle
Programmatic: use SwaggerGenerator as a Java library returning Swagger object
constraints: Requires Java 11 (eclipse-temurin:11-jdk) to run the JAR; Maven 3 required to build from source
OpenDaylight Maven repository configuration (settings.xml) may be required for build dependencies
Docker image allocates a fixed 256MB JVM heap (-Xms256m -Xmx256m); large YANG models may hit OutOfMemoryError
swagger-maven-plugin and swagger-codegen-jaxrs must be present in local Maven repository when used as plugins
Generated Swagger targets OpenAPI 2.0 only — not OpenAPI 3.x
Maven plugin integration is noted as not thoroughly checked in current release
docker_services: yang2swagger (single-container, multi-stage build: maven:3-eclipse-temurin-11 for build, eclipse-temurin:11-jdk for runtime; ENTRYPOINT runs yang-to-swagger.jar; YANG files must be volume-mounted)
notable_absences: No test/validation service or CI runner image
No built-in Swagger UI or live documentation server
No network exposure — tool is purely a file-in/file-out transformer
